## 🧈 Butler specials

- **Butter mode.** Your model marks the parts of a reply that actually move the scene. Tap the butter on a reply and it folds down to just those, perfect for catching up on a long scene.
- **Highlights.** After a reply, Butler asks your model which lines are romantic, dangerous, sad, funny or spicy, and gives them a soft highlight. The reply itself never changes.
- **Rich typing.** `"` `*` `B` keys on the message box, and the formatting shows as you type, like Discord.

Butter mode and Highlights run on your own model, so they cost a few tokens, and how well they work depends on your model. Butler tells you the cost before you turn them on. Find them in Settings › Butler specials.

## New

- **Custom look.** Pick an accent and a background and Butler builds the rest of the theme. Advanced lets you set every colour, and how round the corners are.
- **Any colour for chat text**, on a real colour wheel.
- **Backgrounds.** Keep a library of pictures, one for every chat or a different one per chat. Blur, dim, and a little drift when you tilt your phone.
- **Thinking levels** for OpenRouter models, per proxy (low, medium, high and more).
- **Write for me, on another model.** Write for me doesn't have to use your default model (Settings › Model › Write for me uses).
- **Model settings save when you tap Save**, so switching JLLM and your proxy is instant, and leaving with unsaved changes asks first.

## Added (was missing)

- Switching between a bot's intros at the start of a chat.
- Write something for me / Enhance my draft.
- Persona groups.
- JLLM's Short responses, and Deep reasoning for Janitor+, with what each one does.

## Fixed

- New accounts: JLLM replies failed with error 500, and Settings showed an error until AI settings were saved once.
- Chats opened in Butler for the first time started at the top instead of the latest message.
- Pinned and archived chats could jump around after opening a chat.
